name: opum-quest
description: Drive the quest CLI: create, list, view, edit, complete, and archive tasks, drafts, milestones, and decisions in a Quest-initialized workspace instead of editing tracker state directly. Cut from the same quest-cli repository and tag as the CLI itself, so this skill can never describe a version you don't have. Also ships the Quest board: a pane listing the tasks being worked on in the session's own repository, editable there.

actor.title: Quest actor id
actor.description: Who edits made in the pane are recorded as (--actor, kind human)

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Toast alerts for a decision waiting on you and for notable task changes, checked every two minutes whether or not the pane is open. 'all' toasts both, 'decisions' only the decisions and the status-line count, 'off' neither.
